definitions: A person who propels a boat (especially a narrowboat) through a tunnel by lying on their back and pushing with their legs against the tunnel roof or sides.
A person or animal that has legs of a specified kind or number (often used in combination, e.g., 'long-legger').
examples: The legger worked tirelessly to move the barge.
He was known as a fast legger on the track.
The tunnel required a skilled legger to navigate.
